name: 12V WiFi Router Power Bank UPS with 6 Built-in Cells
shortDescription: Plug-and-play 12V mini UPS that keeps your WiFi router online during load shedding.
description: A compact router power bank with six built-in rechargeable cells that takes over automatically when mains power cuts out. Keeps 12V fiber routers, ONTs and modems running so your internet stays on through outages.
highlights: 12V DC output for fiber routers and ONTs

specifications.label: Battery
specifications.value: 6 built-in rechargeable cells (total capacity not specified)

specifications.label: Compatibility
specifications.value: 12V WiFi routers, fiber ONTs and modems

specifications.label: Backup time
specifications.value: Not specified (depends on router power draw)
